codeReview.summary: No implementation artifacts were produced for this follow-up feature, and the repository still contains the exact blocking conditions from the earlier failed reviews: content.ts never calls destroyOverlay()/destroyBadge(), and ContentScriptHandler.destroy() is still never wired to pagehide/beforeunload or any other teardown path.

issues.description: ContentScriptHandler.destroy() still calls overlayController.clearActionOverlay() instead of destroyOverlay(), so the overlay root/style nodes introduced by ActionOverlayController remain attached to the page DOM when teardown runs. This leaves VAL-CRIT-001 unresolved.

ContentScriptHandler.destroy() still calls subagentBadgeController.clearBadge() instead of destroyBadge(), so the badge bar/tag/style nodes are hidden but not removed from the DOM. This leaves the badge-leak portion of VAL-CRIT-001 unresolved.

The file still ends with new ContentScriptHandler() and contains no pagehide/beforeunload teardown wiring, so destroy() is unreachable in practice and the stored runtime listener is never removed. This means the follow-up feature did not resolve VAL-CRIT-003 either.
